title: Sony 6 Hrs T-120 VHS VCR Tapes Blank Premium Grade - Sealed/Unopened
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:TV, Video & Audio Accessories:Blank Audio/Video Media:VHS Video Tapes
descriptionText: The Sony 6 Hrs T-120 VHS VCR Tapes are premium-grade blank tapes designed for recording VHS videos. With a capacity of 6 hours, these tapes are ideal for capturing long-form videos without the need for frequent interruptions. Made by Sony, a reputable brand in the electronics industry, these tapes are guaranteed to provide high-quality recordings. Perfect for home use or professional recording needs, these tapes are sealed and unopened, ensuring they are ready to use right out of the packaging.
